The fork branch matches the required commit, and the reset left a clean tree. GitHub’s unauthenticated API is rate-limited until 20:19 UTC; I’ll inspect the code while waiting, then retry the review requests before editing.I’ve read the review. Its label-retention reasoning matches `src/server.ts`: refresh updates server-side descriptors but announces only new conversations, while a write’s `to` uses the server registry. I’ll document that distinction without changing production code.

The baseline passes 602 tests on both Node versions. I’ll add configurable workspace names, registration/write coverage for hostile and empty names, and refresh coverage that checks both `added` and `channels/changed`.The final commit passes all required gates: 605 tests on each Node version, up from 602 at baseline. All three new tests fail against the parent’s `src/channels.ts` and pass after byte-for-byte restoration. Production files are unchanged, and the tree is clean. I’m writing the report and finalizing the dispatch.
